transcript: We don't truly experience the world as it is. We experience it through our nervous system. Two people can stand in the same place, under the same sky, living the same moment, and feel completely different inside. One may feel calm and open, another may feel tense, afraid and overwhelmed. The difference is not the situation, it is the state of the body. When the nervous system feels safe, life feels lighter. When it lives in survival, even good things feel heavy. This is why learning to feel safe inside your body can be more important than changing everything around you. You can improve your environment, you can achieve, build and collect. But if the body does not feel safe, joy cannot land. This is not meant to scare you, it is meant to bring clarity. Healing begins when we stop fighting the body and start listening to it. As 26 begins, remember this, a new year does not require a new version of you. It asks for a safer one, a calmer one, a body that no longer lives in survival. The 30-day healing journey was created for this, a quiet way to begin the year by restoring safety one day at a time. If this feels like the right moment for you, the journey is waiting in the link in my bio. No rush, just a gentle beginning for 26.
